en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a panoramic, snow-covered mountain landscape. The scene includes several peaks and ridges, with heavy snow accumulation. The foreground shows a steep, snowy slope, while the background displays a range of volcanic domes. The image features printed annotations in French, labeling parts of the landscape such as 'Congère de 30 m. d'épaisseur' and 'Les Dômes Nord.' The bottom of the postcard contains a caption describing the scene and referencing a railway.
